title: La Jolla E-Scooter Tour with Photos Included
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for travelers who do not have bicycle experience or are uncomfortable on a bike
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us on a journey through one of San Diego's most iconic areas, La Jolla! We will be touring the major sites with the wind in our hair on electric scooters. No walking required ;) 

See the sea lions at La Jolla Cove, watch the waves crash at Windansea Beach, and check out some of San Diego’s most lavish neighborhoods while learning some history on a tour that’s suitable for all levels of rider. 

As an added bonus, we will be taking pictures of you along the way at some of our favorite scenic spots which you will receive for free at the end of the tour. 

If you want to see the jewel of San Diego in a unique way with a local guide, then this is the tour for you!
